title.zh: 承认 Southville International School 为具有国际性质的教育机构、给予加快其发展的特定特权并为其他目的法案
title.en: An Act Recognizing Southville International School as an Educational Institution of International Character, Granting Certain Prerogatives to Hasten Its Growth as such, and for other purposes
title.orig: An Act Recognizing Southville International School as an Educational Institution of International Character, Granting Certain Prerogatives to Hasten Its Growth as such, and for other purposes

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2007/ra_9493_2007.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Southville International School, herein referred to as the School, is hereby declared an educational institution of international character authorized to operate educational programs that primarily and principally adhere to universally accepted and recognized educational policies.

The Southville International School, Inc. shall be the registered name of the School and shall have as its members the school management and the parents or guardians, whether of Philippine or foreign nationality, of the children who have enrolled and attended the School for at least one school year: Provided , That the school year shall he determined in accordance with the School's own calendar of studies and workschedule: Provided, further , That the School shall be governed by a Board of Trustees, herein referred to as the Board, elected at large from among the corporation's members of good standing.
The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.
If any clause, sentence, paragraph or part of this Act is subsequently declared unconstitutional, the validity of the remaining provisions hereof shall remain in full force and effect.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
